and death would have been minutes. On his death certificate, the manner of death is listed as an
accident. Fifty-eight-year-old Stephanie Shanks pleaded guilty to felony and voluntary manslaughter,
as well as two misdemeanor charges of endangering children, and was sentenced to four to six
years in prison.
